psychological_meaning: Neptune evokes feelings of tranquility, peace, and serenity, reminiscent of the sea after which it's named. It encourages introspection and a sense of calm, providing a soothing effect on the mind and promoting relaxation and mental clarity.

real_world_examples.title: Coastal Living Room
real_world_examples.description: A living room painted in Neptune creates a serene and inviting atmosphere, perfect for relaxation and unwinding.

real_world_examples.title: Spa Branding
real_world_examples.description: Neptune is used in spa branding to convey a sense of calmness and tranquility, enhancing the overall experience.

how_to_pair: Pair with whites for a clean and airy feel.
Combine with natural wood tones for warmth.
Use with darker blues for depth and contrast.
